city_model.name: Emmer-Compascuum
city_model.description: Emmer-Compascuum test area: BAG + 3DBAG LoD 0/1/2 + EP-online, extended with PV panel polygons from the University of Groningen aerial-imagery dataset (Zenodo 14860030, CC-BY-4.0) and LoD3 tree reconstructions from CFTree (AHN4 LiDAR -> HOMED + TreeSeparation + CGAL alpha-wrap), optionally enriched with OSM species/leaf_type and Landelijk Register Monumentale Bomen. Boundary polygon from inputs/emmer_compascuum_area.geojson.
